name: Startling Sniper (Combat)
body:
You are amazingly gifted at performing ranged ambushes.

Prerequisite: Stealth 5 ranks, Point-Blank Shot, Sniper, Stealthy

Benefit: If you’ve already successfully used Stealth at least 10 feet from your target, you can make one ranged attack and then immediately use Stealth again. You take no penalty on your Stealth check to maintain your obscured location.
